subject: environmental-science
title: UK Nature: Rivers & Wetlands
welcome_lead: Wet places are some of the busiest spots for wildlife in the UK.
meta_desc: KS3 environmental science: UK rivers, ponds, wetlands.

concepts.def: Land covered by water for much of the year.
Playful river mammal that eats fish.
Bright blue bird diving for fish.
Fast insect of ponds and rivers.

walkthroughs.body_html: Rivers like the Severn, Thames and Tyne host fish, otters and kingfishers. Clean rivers mean healthy wildlife.
Even small ponds are buzzing with frogs, newts and dragonflies. Adding a pond to a garden is a quick wildlife win.
Wetlands like marshes and fens filter water and protect against floods. They also lock up huge amounts of carbon in peat soil.
